items.prompt: It is essential that she ___ time to reflect.
items.hintAfterError: Subjuntivo formal: depois de 'It is essential that' o verbo fica na forma base, mesmo com 'she'.

items.prompt: I recommend that the board ___ informed first.
items.hintAfterError: No subjuntivo, o verbo 'to be' aparece na forma base.

items.prompt: It is important that the coach ___ to conclusions.
items.hintAfterError: No subjuntivo a negativa é só 'not' + forma base, sem auxiliar.

items.prompt: I insist that the feedback ___ confidential.
It is vital that every leader ___ a 360 review.
items.hintAfterError: Subjuntivo: forma base, sem -s na 3ª pessoa.
